added_failures_note: Derived from baseline_suite baseline.log: 58 passed, EXIT=0, and after_suite after.log: 61 passed, EXIT=0; both complete with no FAILED IDs. Separate importer arms each record 16 failed and 278 passed with identical failure IDs.
assertion_independence: No input/echo assertion found. Age zero requires the asynchronous beat to follow an independently advanced clock; byte comparisons use pre-operation captures; watcher_ensure_line is the existing remedy owner, not an input supplied to poll.

assertion_review.fails_if: Publisher never runs or the initial positive-control heartbeat cannot be read.
The publication wrapper never enters while contention is held.
Restoring SQLite heartbeat writes blocks the store cases; restoring synchronous publication blocks home cases. The negative-control receipt shows all three failing at window zero.
A fresh beat beside an old running tick is incorrectly classified as live or stopped.

assertion_review.assertion: No producer-lost rows and no remedy
assertion_review.fails_if: The pane emits loss or re-arm instructions despite a fresh local beat.

assertion_review.assertion: remote_advanced during store contention and after release
assertion_review.fails_if: Database contention blocks off-node publication, or shared publication fails to catch up after release.

assertion_review.assertion: beat._thread is None and no named threads enumerate
assertion_review.fails_if: Stop leaves the thread reference or a running beat/publisher after contention has been released; the reference assertion alone does not prove termination.
A heartbeat operation rewrites the independently captured obligation export.
Foreign identity, malformed/older timestamp, non-mapping record or invalid JSON overrides the stale stored heartbeat.
An already-lost guard is ignored by the local heartbeat write.
The fenced operation alters the heartbeat bytes captured independently before the operation.

assertion_review.assertion: Stopped state, producer-lost event and watcher remedy
assertion_review.fails_if: Stopping renewal fails to age into stopped, suppresses the loss row or emits a remedy differing from the existing watcher command owner.

reckon/crew/watch_unit.py:1086 ProducerSnapshotNotices.poll reads the local tick

0.reason: a shutdown edge: stop() can return with the publisher daemon still finishing a blocked publication; it affects only station shutdown, not the beat during a tick, and the review found no behaviour defect in the fix itself

findings.text: non-blocking: stop() discards the publisher reference after a timed join without checking whether blocked shared publication has finished, so it can return with that daemon still alive and able to complete publication after stop; the new contention test releases publication before checking shutdown, leaving this condition unguarded.

item_verdicts.diff: Read the single commit against adde3bdc2df67f40b2f3f7a551d6f754774c65f5; its four-file diff introduces a store-bound local heartbeat, coalesced publication, reader integration and three contention cases, with one bounded-shutdown caveat.
item_verdicts.done_when: Live plan s28 and prompt.txt:274 require contention, stopped-station behavior and no added importer failures; reproduction.log records 3 stale-beat failures, after.log records 61 passes, negative-control.log records 3 stale-beat failures and the importer logs record identical 16 failure IDs.
item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:38 asks to keep the station heartbeat moving through a long tick; station.py:131-192 separates local beats from database writes and shared publication.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md names the reviewed commit and readable baseline, head, reproduction and control logs that corroborate its results, including the unchanged importer failures.
item_verdicts.write_paths: All four changed files in commit 460c9c3faa0a39593dde24b73e1ff5541d38fd83 are among the six paths declared in prompt.txt:338; no unrelated files changed.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_station_beat_survives_a_long_tick.py:89-100 fails when SQLite heartbeat writes and synchronous publication are restored, as negative-control.log demonstrates, while its shutdown check only covers publication released before stop.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_the_station_beat_survives_a_long_tick.py:89-110 crosses three stale windows per contention mode, and reproduction.log, after.log, negative-control.log and the paired importer logs record the required red/green results.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/station.py:133 reuses the atomic JSON writer and obligation_snapshot.py:519 extends the existing health reader with mechanism-based names and surrounding thread/event idioms.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/station.py:131-192 keeps local liveness independent of SQLite writer contention and shared publication, while obligation_snapshot.py:519-550 supplies the fresh beat to existing readers.
justifications.reuse: Capability searches for heartbeat, publication and coalescing found obligation_snapshot.py:388/519 and reckon/_store.py:616 as owners that this change extends or calls; host_heartbeat.py:112 renews host file mtimes rather than store-bound station health and owns no coalescing publisher to reuse.
justifications.scope_discipline: The diff changes only reckon/crew/station.py, station_store.py, obligation_snapshot.py and the newly declared contention test.

limitations: Virtual time spans three stale windows; a held SQLite transaction and blocked publisher wrapper model contention, not a deployed GPFS stall.
Independent review read the recorded tests without rerunning the suite.
Non-blocking shutdown finding awaits coordinator disposition; source repair is outside this review scope.
